selection.classifier: aws normalized prompt hash + classification text hash + chosen niche + llm; verseodin native niche

limitations: Within the measured prompt panel; not all AI demand or real-world query volume.
Distinct source mappings remain raw associations, not impressions, conversions or independent fit labels. Retrieval ranks each normalized prompt once.
Historical brands are references, not enrolled bidders or declarations of fictional campaign capabilities.
Hints are inferred historical hypotheses, not advertiser configuration; sparse tier is retained.
No raw probes, answers, HTML, URLs, images, geo, customers, credentials or import-spread timestamps exported.
Model revision is unrecorded. Only existing matching BGE 768-D prompt vectors; no embedding generation or provider calls.
Vectors are backend-only. publicCatalogue and retrieval/model packets never return vectors.
Exact cached text uses vector cosine; authored uncached text uses labelled lexical fallback. No training, targeting accuracy or causal-lift claim.
